description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_BigInteger, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Integer and represents a big integer value in the Zend XmlRpc value system. It requires external dependencies for big integer mathematics.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_BigInteger
classes.description: A class representing a big integer value in the Zend XML-RPC system, extending the Integer value class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the big integer value using Zend_Crypt_Math_BigInteger and sets the XMLRPC type.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the big integer value as a string.
